usageNotes: Use this to list all LXC containers across a registered PDM remote, optionally scoped to a single node. Omitting the `node` parameter queries every node in the cluster, which is useful for a full inventory but may return a large result set on busy clusters. The caller must hold the `Resource.Audit` privilege on the remote resource path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: List all LXC containers on a specific node of a remote cluster

tips: All resource metrics (cpu, mem, disk, netin, netout) are live point-in-time snapshots and are absent for stopped containers.
Containers marked as templates (template: true) are included in the result; filter them out if you only want running or manageable instances.
The `lock` field being set means the container is mid-operation (backup, migration, snapshot) — avoid actions on locked containers.
Pressure stall fields (pressurecpusome, pressureiofull, etc.) are only populated on kernels with PSI support (Linux 4.20+).
